zombie-and-animal-bait.intro: Type these in game chat. /t, /tame and /thralls work in place of /thrall, and thrall in the F1 console does the same. A number comes from /thrall list, and a thrall's name works anywhere a number does.

Your Bait UI version and the server's Bait version.

drone-loot-filter.intro: Type these in game chat. The server can change the /dai prefix in its settings.

What the drone took recently, numbered.
Ignore item n from /dai last.

spawn-tuner.intro: Server console commands. Settings: DayDensity, NightDensity, AnimalDayDensity, AnimalNightDensity (none, default or 1 to 100); DayRespawn, NightRespawn, AnimalDayRespawn, AnimalNightRespawn (default, veryslow, slow, normal, fast, veryfast); BloodMoonCount, MaxZombies, MaxAnimals; HordeFrequency and HordeSize (percent, 100 is vanilla).

rows.does: Every setting, now and the world's value.

Back to the world's own value.

Stop ramping it.
Save every change as a preset.
Switch to a preset. Replaces every change.
List the presets.
Restart respawn timers in loaded areas so changes show now.
Re-read spawns.txt.
